BiblicalUsage: Rabrab is huge — great in size, domineering in character. Daniel uses it of Nebuchadnezzar's greatness, of the greatness of God's signs and wonders, and of the little horn on the fourth beast, whose look was more stout than his fellows.
TheologicalSignificance: What strikes me is that the word teaches me to measure greatness rightly: man's greatness passes, and God's signs are great forever.
